_: Scene PLAYIDLE performance (IDEAS §1b 'play animation'): a scene whose actor PLAYS AN IDLE ANIMATION on a phase boundary, not just talks. The fourth scene-action kind (after Dialog/Package/Timer): an idle action (`idle` ref on a SceneActionSpec) is realised NOT as a SceneAction but as a SCEN SceneAdapter per-phase begin fragment (SF_<scene>.Fragment_N) that runs <alias>.GetActorRef().PlayIdle(<idle>), decoded from vanilla SF_BardSongsBallad01Scene / SF_MQ201EscapeScene. Composition (kneel -> pause -> stand) is plain phases + a Timer, no bespoke enter/hold/exit. The supplicant kneels, murmurs a prayer, then rises.
